shapeSummary: Low-profile square sensor enclosure, 22 x 22 mm and 9 mm tall (Y up, bottom at Y=0). Four 5 x 5 x 2.5 mm corner mounting tabs at the base bring the footprint to 28 x 28 mm. Each tab has a 2 mm vertical through hole.
warnings: The 28 x 28 x 9 mm size comes from an unverified listing. It was assumed to include the tabs.
The photo suggests the tabs may sit on the sides rather than at the corners. I used four corner tabs, following the image analysis.
The body width (22 mm), tab size, tab thickness and hole positions are rough visual estimates.
The side wire connector, wire leads and expansion connector are not modelled.
The five threaded M1.4 mounting holes are omitted because their positions are not visible or stated.
The bottom central hole, the fastener heads, and the printed labels and axis diagram are omitted.
cadquery:
body = cq.Workplane('XY').box(22, 9, 22, centered=(True, False, True))
tabs = (cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(-11.5, -11.5), (11.5, -11.5), (-11.5, 11.5), (11.5, 11.5)])
        .rect(5, 5).extrude(2.5))
tabs = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(-11.5, -11.5), (11.5, -11.5), (-11.5, 11.5), (11.5, 11.5)]).rect(5, 5).extrude(-2.5)
holes = (cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, -1, 0))
         .pushPoints([(-12, -12), (12, -12), (-12, 12), (12, 12)])
         .circle(1.0).extrude(-4))
part = body.union(tabs).cut(holes)
